extra.reason: Fixed: moved advanceToResult useCallback above the early returns in match-flow-wizard.tsx so hook order is stable. Verified via npm run typecheck (all 3 workspaces clean).

Fixed: signUp now returns needsEmailConfirmation flag based on whether Supabase returned a session. Signup screen shows contextual copy (Check your email vs Account created). Also added emailRedirectTo: elorated://login so confirmation links route back into the app.

Synced apps/web/public/design/ with upstream SharePoint brand kit. Added tokens.css + wireframe.html, refactored style guide to link canonical tokens, deleted orphan rebrand.html, added /design/wireframe Next.js route + nav link. Web globals.css and mobile tokens.ts verified to mirror canonical token values 1:1; no app code changes needed.

Verified fixed on development branch (2026-05-26 audit). jits-zyq + jits-9l4: createInSessionMatch in apps/web/hooks/use-session-lobby-realtime.ts:172 and apps/mobile/app/(app)/session/[id]/lobby.tsx:80-82 both omit timekeeperId now (caller is no longer passed as timekeeper). jits-y91: all 4 router.* navigation calls in apps/web/hooks/use-session-lobby-realtime.ts use router.push (lines 86, 110, 122, 176), not router.replace. jits-e0w: apps/mobile/components/match-flow/steps/confirm-step.tsx wires useMatchCompletion (postgres_changes on matches row) + a myConfirmed && opponentConfirmed effect; auto-advance works for DB-side confirms. jits-65p: both apps/web/app/(app)/match/[id]/results/submission-fields.tsx:70 and apps/mobile/components/match-flow/steps/submission-fields.tsx:52 label finish_time as '(optional)' correctly.
